spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Early morning in a simple shared university dormitory room in Sanchong, New Taipei: bunk bed, a small desk, morning light through the window. The man stands by the door swinging his black backpack onto his shoulder, ready to leave. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
